description: Implement ask_user tool for Main Agent to ask questions during execution, with question API and Web UI panel

tasks.title: Add questions table migration (v6)
tasks.description: Add migration v6 to db/schema.ts creating questions table: id TEXT PK, issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, question TEXT NOT NULL, answer TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, answered_at TEXT.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration v6 runs successfully
questions table exists with correct schema
Existing tables unaffected

tasks.title: Create QuestionRepo
tasks.description: Create db/question-repo.ts with QuestionRepo class. Methods: create(issueId, question), answer(id, answer), findByIssueId(issueId), findById(id), expire(id), findPendingByIssueId(issueId).
acceptanceCriteria: QuestionRepo with all required methods
create generates UUID and sets created_at
answer updates status, answer text, and answered_at
findByIssueId returns ordered by created_at DESC
findPendingByIssueId filters status='pending'
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Add question events to EventBus
tasks.description: Add 'question_asked' and 'question_answered' to EventMap. Add to ALL_EVENT_TYPES in api/events.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: EventMap includes question_asked and question_answered types
ALL_EVENT_TYPES includes both new types
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Straightforward addition to the type union and array.

tasks.title: Implement ask_user tool
tasks.description: Create tools/ask-user.ts implementing the ask_user tool. It should: (1) accept question string parameter, (2) create question record via QuestionRepo, (3) emit question_asked event, (4) return a Promise that blocks until resolved via a pending resolver Map, (5) include 24h timeout (configurable) with Promise.race. Export createAskUserTool factory function accepting { questionRepo, eventBus, projectId, timeoutMs? }.
acceptanceCriteria: tools/ask-user.ts exists with createAskUserTool factory
Tool ID is 'ask_user'
execute creates question in DB, emits event, returns blocking Promise
Timeout resolves with default message after 24h
Pending resolver Map allows external resolution
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The key design: a module-level or instance-level Map<string, Function> stores resolvers. The factory function returns both the tool definition AND a resolveQuestion(id, answer) function that the API handler can call.

tasks.title: Create questions API routes
tasks.description: Create api/questions.ts with: GET /api/questions?issueId=xxx (list), GET /api/questions/:id (detail), POST /api/questions/:id/reply (answer). The reply endpoint must call ask_user tool's resolver to unblock the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/questions?issueId=xxx returns questions array
POST /api/questions/:id/reply { answer } updates DB and resolves Promise
reply endpoint emits question_answered event
Returns 404 for non-existent question IDs
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The reply handler needs access to the ask_user resolver. This means the ask_user module must export a way to resolve questions externally. Design this as a shared service or singleton.

tasks.title: Register ask_user tool in Main Agent and update prompt
tasks.description: Register ask_user tool in agents/main-agent.ts. Update buildSystemPrompt to include ask_user usage guidelines: when to use (ambiguous requirements, user decision needed), when not to use (can solve with tools, clear best practice), one question at a time, specific and actionable questions.
acceptanceCriteria: ask_user tool registered in main-agent.ts ToolRegistry
System prompt includes ask_user description and usage guidelines
Main agent can call ask_user during execution
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The system prompt update is important — it guides the LLM on when to use ask_user vs solving independently.

tasks.title: Wire everything in server/index.ts
tasks.description: Create QuestionRepo in server/index.ts. Create ask_user tool instance with proper dependencies. Pass to main-agent context. Mount questions API routes.
acceptanceCriteria: QuestionRepo created and passed to ask_user tool factory
ask_user tool registered in main agent
Questions API routes mounted on server
End-to-end: agent can ask question, user can reply via API, agent continues
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The tricky part is sharing the resolver between the tool and the API handler. Consider a shared AskUserService singleton.

tasks.title: Add question panel to Web UI
tasks.description: Add question panel to IssueDetailPage.tsx: (1) Listen for question_asked SSE event, (2) Show pending questions with input field, (3) Submit calls POST /api/questions/:id/reply, (4) On question_answered, refresh and remove from pending. Add types for question events in types.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueDetailPage shows question panel when pending questions exist
User can type and submit answer
Panel updates after answer submitted
No panel shown when no pending questions
Web UI build passes
tasks.notes: Keep the UI simple — a section below the comments area. Use the existing SSE hook pattern.

tasks.title: Handle server restart pending questions
tasks.description: On server startup, query all pending questions from DB and mark them as expired (since the agent session is lost on restart). This prevents orphaned questions.
acceptanceCriteria: On server start, pending questions in DB are marked as expired
No orphaned pending questions after restart
tasks.notes: Simple cleanup: in server startup, call questionRepo.expireAllPending().

tasks.title: Verify build and end-to-end test
tasks.description: Run full build (CLI + Web UI), typecheck, and manual end-to-end test: start server, create issue with ambiguous requirement, start agent, verify agent asks question, reply via API, verify agent continues.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build succeeds
Web UI build succeeds
Typecheck passes
End-to-end: ask_user flow works through full cycle
tasks.notes: The manual test is the real acceptance test. The issue description should be ambiguous enough to trigger a question.
